meaning: to turn something around by holding both ends
example: Twist the cap to open the bottle.

meaning: to pull paper or cloth apart into pieces
example: Be careful not to tear the page.

meaning: to put things together so they become one
example: Mix the flour and water well.

meaning: to bite food many times in your mouth
example: Chew your food slowly.

meaning: to move food or drink down your throat
example: It hurts when I swallow.

meaning: to say something very loudly
example: Do not shout at the children.

meaning: to make happy sounds because something is funny
example: We laughed a lot at his joke.

meaning: to have tears come from your eyes
example: The baby started to cry at night.

meaning: to turn your mouth up to show you are happy
example: She always smiles when she sees me.

meaning: to move on foot at a normal speed
example: I walk to the office every morning.

meaning: to move on foot faster than walking
example: He runs five kilometres every day.

meaning: to rest your body on a chair or the floor
example: Please sit here and wait for me.

meaning: to move on your hands and knees
example: The baby is learning to crawl.

meaning: to bend your body or rest against something
example: Do not lean on the wall.

meaning: to move your head up and down to say yes
example: He nodded when I asked the question.

meaning: to take hold of something quickly and firmly
example: Grab your bag and let us go.

meaning: to put something where no one can see it

meaning: to look carefully for something
example: I searched everywhere for my keys.

meaning: to go and bring something back
example: Can you fetch a glass of water for me?

meaning: to move something quickly up and down or side to side
example: Shake the bottle before you use it.

meaning: to take the skin off a fruit or vegetable
example: Please peel the potatoes for dinner.

meaning: to cover a surface with a thin layer or open something out
example: Spread some butter on the bread.

meaning: to start a machine or light so it works

meaning: to stop a machine or light so it does not work

meaning: to return something to its proper place
